span.p: Cost + telemetry attribution

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Remote: ApiCostUsd = PromptTokenCount/1e6 × InputPrice
+ TokenCount/1e6 × OutputPrice — only when a price exists

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

gen_ai.client.operation.duration · gen_ai.usage.input_tokens
· gen_ai.usage.output_tokens

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
NOT emitted as metrics: WarmUpDurationMs (TTFT)
and TokenVelocity — persisted per row only

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Local / LocalService: EnergyWh = TdpWatts × ms/3.6e6
EnergyCostUsd = Wh/1000 × GreenStats:ElectricityRateUsd (0.12)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5;

span.p: Fallback + resilience policy

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Polly pipeline 'foundry-inference' — retry only, 2 attempts,
250 ms exponential, on HttpRequestException / 5xx / 408.
NO per-attempt timeout: it would abort the SSE stream.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
In-proxy retry — 3 attempts on 429 / 502 / 503.
429 honours Retry-After, clamped 1–90 s.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
HttpClient.Timeout = AzureAiFoundry:RemoteTimeoutSeconds
default 120 s, clamped 30–900. Phi-4 Mini cold start needs it.

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Judge 429 → JudgeRateLimitedException(Retry-After ≤ 60 s)
→ AutoJudge requeues, ≤ AiJudge:RateLimitRetryMax (2)

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Duel watchdog: CancellationTokenSource(900 s) over both sides

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Parameter shaping — FoundryChatRequest.Build
reasoning (gpt-5* / o1 / o3 / o4): max_completion_tokens, temperature OMITTED
classic: max_tokens + temperature 0.7
duel budget 16 384 (reasoning) / 4 096 (classic)
judge budget 2 000 + response_format json_schema
stream_options.include_usage ONLY for native Azure OpenAI prefixes
(gpt- o1 o3 o4 phi- llama- grok-) — Codestral 2501 422s on it

div.style: color: rgb(11, 18, 32) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:

from Key Vault (prefix PoLocalCompare) or user-secrets
